guardAndTraversalEvidence: NO base-directory containment check exists anywhere in the include/attr resolution pipeline: get_snippet_path (snippets.py:155-174) does os.path.join(base, path) with no post-join containment validation (no relative_to/abspath-prefix/startswith check, unlike some other projects in this series), and b64.py:78-80 normpaths the joined or absolute path without any base check - normpath collapses '..' segments but the result can still resolve outside base_path

Mixed separators / decode-before-join: util.parse_url applies html.unescape (util.py:119 - HTML-entity decoding) and rewrites backslashes to forward slashes in file:// handling (util.py:129/:134/:142); util.url2path applies url2pathname (util.py:56 - percent-decoding); encoded traversals (%2e%2e%2f, .) decode into plain ../ BEFORE os.path.join

Absolute-path acceptance: util.parse_url sets is_absolute for file:///path (:137-139), file://c:/path and file://\\... forms (:127-136), c:/ drive-letter schemes (:140-145), // UNC paths (:146-151) and leading / or \\ paths (:155-157); b64.py:77-78 then takes the direct os.path.normpath(path) branch for absolute values, reading outside base_path by construction

Downloaded-content guard: parse_snippets ignores non-link include references when is_url is true (snippets.py:293-296) - this constrains nested includes only INSIDE downloaded URL content; the original document's local include paths remain unguarded
